title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or Go, with strong foundational knowledge in data structures and algorithms.
description: Work on core product developments and high-scale systems that impact millions of users globally alongside senior mentorship.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: International graduate students, young professionals, and artists from participating countries.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, Monthly Living Stipend, Health Insurance, Flight)
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with strong academic record and leadership potential.
description: Enables international students to complete a Master's or PhD degree in the United States while fostering cross-cultural exchange.

title: Junior Data Analyst
eligibility: Open to early-career candidates globally with remote work capabilities.
qualification: Proficiency in SQL, basic Python or R knowledge, and experience with modern BI tools like Tableau or Looker.
description: Analyze key product metrics and operational data to deliver actionable insights driving strategic growth across a fully distributed company.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or candidates with 0-2 years of product or engineering experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Define feature specs, collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, and guide technical product strategy for cloud and consumer tools.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16 and older enrolled in high school or higher education institutions.
salary: $100,000 USD Grand Prize + Azure Credits & Mentorship
qualification: Innovative software project leveraging Microsoft Azure and AI technologies.
description: A global student tech competition where teams build purpose-driven AI solutions to address real-world societal and industrial challenges.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with an internet connection.
qualification: No prior programming or computer science experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching fundamental computer science concepts, algorithmic thinking, and languages including C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
